posts.text: I am, like so many others, also leaving Twitter. I deactivated my account last week but have decided to reactivate and lock it down so that no one else can post under my handle. However, I will not be using X going forward. I cannot in good conscience justify remaining here any longer. I am on IG @nikolehannahjones and also on Bluesky under this handle, but am not sure how much I will post there. Thank you for following and for all the times when this place was once good.
